description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP

PROBLEM INFO:

- A division of an auto parts manufacturer produces \var{P} different parts using \var{M} different machines.
- Batch of 100 part \var{p} requires \var{time_{m,p}} hours on machine \var{m}.
- The division incurs a charge of \var{cost_{m}} per hour for using machine \var{m}.
- Machine \var{m} has an availability of up to \var{available_{m}} hours per month.
- The division sells part \var{p} in batches of 100 at price of \var{price_{p}} per batch.
- The division must produce at least \var{min_batches_{p}} batches of part \var{p} each month to fulfill a contract.
- Extra available time for machine \var{m} can be acquired at $\var{extra_costs_{m}}/hour. 
- Up to \var{max_extra_{m}} hours can be purchased for each machine \var{m}.

INPUT FORMAT: 

{
    "time_required": [[time_{m,p} for p in 1, ..., P] for m in 1, ..., M],
    "machine_costs": [cost_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "availability": [available_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "prices": [price_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "min_batches": [min_batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "extra_costs": [extra_cost_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "max_extra": [max_extra_{m} for m in 1, ..., M]
}

OBJECTIVE: How many batches of each part should the manufacturer produce each month to maximize profit?

OUTPUT INFO:

- the number of batches of each part produced \var{batches_{p}}.
- \var{extra_time} denotes the additional hours purchased for each machine \var{m}.
- \var{total_profit} represents the total profit obtained for the month.

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "batches": [batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "extra_time": [extra_time_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "total_profit": total_profit
}

TimeRequired.definition: Time required to produce a batch of part p on machine m

MachineCosts.definition: Cost associated with running machine m

Availability.definition: Availability of machine m for production each month

Prices.definition: Price obtained from selling a batch of part p

MinBatches.definition: Minimum number of batches of part p that should be produced

ExtraCosts.definition: Extra cost incurred when running machine m beyond regular operation

MaxExtra.definition: Maximum extra hours machine m can be run

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total monthly profit from producing and selling batches of parts, accounting for machine operating costs and any additional time purchase costs."

constraints.description: For each machine m: Sum over all parts p of (TimeRequired[m][p] * batches[p]) must be less than or equal to Availability[m] + extra_time[m]
constraints.formulation: $\\forall m = 1, \\dots, M:\\; \\sum_{p=1}^{P} TimeRequired[m,p] \\cdot batches[p] \\leq Availability[m] + extraTime[m]$

constraints.description: For each machine m: 0 <= extra_time[m] <= MaxExtra[m]
For each part p: batches[p] must be greater than or equal to MinBatches[p]

batches.definition: Number of batches of part p produced each month

extraTime.definition: Additional hours purchased for machine m beyond regular availability
